source.删除后其共享设置一并移除，确定？: This removes its shares too. Continue?
source.导入将覆盖当前 config.toml(含全部平台与凭证),确定?: This replaces the current config.toml (including all providers and credentials). Continue?
source.导入将覆盖你在本服务的平台配置(含全部凭证),确定?: This replaces your platform configuration on this service (including all credentials). Continue?
source.修改将写入 config.toml: Changes will be written to config.toml
source.修改将写入 history.db（本用户配置）: Changes will be written to history.db (this user's config)
source.允许普通用户自行添加/编辑自己的供应商: Allow regular users to add/edit their own providers
source.允许访客在登录页注册账号(注册账号均为普通用户): Allow guest registration on the sign-in page (new accounts are regular users)
source.新建账号均为普通用户（系统只存在一个管理员）: New accounts are always regular users (the system has a single admin)
source.用量占比 = (最大余额 - 当前余额) ÷ 最大余额: Usage progress = (max balance - current balance) / max balance
source.用量进度 = (最大余额 - 当前余额) ÷ 最大余额；此上限适用于本供应商的每: Usage progress = (max balance - current balance) / max balance; applies to every account of this provider.
source.留空=不显示余额进度条: Empty = hide the balance progress bar
source.留空保持不变；支持 env:VARNAME 引用环境变量: Empty keeps the current value; env:VARNAME is supported
source.登录对应的 OpenDesign 账号并确认授权，凭证会自动保存。: Sign in to the corresponding OpenDesign account and confirm; the credential is saved automatically.
source.点击上方链接，在 OpenDesign 页面登录并确认授权；本页会自动完成。: Open the link above, sign in and confirm on the OpenDesign page; this page completes automatically.
source.等待你在 OpenDesign 页面登录并确认授权…: Waiting for you to sign in and confirm on the OpenDesign page…
source.官方授权地址无效，请重试。: The official authorization URL is invalid. Try again.
source.授权已取消，可重新登录授权。: Authorization cancelled. You can start again.
source.授权已完成，但配置回显失败，请重新加载配置页。: Authorization completed, but the configuration could not be refreshed. Reload the configuration page.
source.授权成功，凭证已自动保存；其余修改请点保存。: Authorization succeeded; the credential was saved automatically. Click Save for other changes.
source.授权状态异常，请重新登录授权。: Unexpected authorization state. Please start again.
source.未收到授权结果，请重新加载配置。: No authorization result received. Reload the configuration.
source.暂时无法检查授权，稍后自动重试；也可取消后重试。: Authorization status is temporarily unavailable; retrying shortly. You can also cancel and retry.
source.你已拒绝本次授权，可重新登录授权。: You declined this authorization. You can start again.
source.最大余额需为大于等于 0 的有限数字: Max balance must be a finite number >= 0
source.密码已修改,其他登录会话已失效: Password changed; other sessions have been signed out
source.已保存，下次刷新生效: Saved; effective on the next refresh
source.没有控制密钥也可通过网页登录授权；每个套餐可连接一个 OpenDesign 账号: Without a control key, use web login authorization; each plan can connect one OpenDesign account.
source.授权码（官方页面需要时填写）: Authorization code (if requested by the official page)
source.正在显示全部合计；点击查看第 1 条: Showing the total; click to view item 1
source.?其所有登录会话将失效。: ? all of their sessions will be signed out.
source.设置新密码(至少 6 位):: Set a new password (at least 6 characters):
source.填了就覆盖网关面板的日报额度(面板的周/月额度不受影响): Overrides the gateway daily quota (weekly/monthly are unaffected)
source.已有账号?登录: Already have an account? Sign in
source.忽略缓存，立即重新获取各平台用量: Ignore cache and refresh all platforms now
source.管理员已关闭普通用户自行配置供应商: The admin has disabled user provider configuration
source.选择要添加的供应商类型: Choose a provider type to add

messages.认证失败(401)：请检查 API key: Authentication failed (401): check the API key
messages.认证失败(401)：请确认使用的是 Kimi Code 控制台的 sk-kimi: Authentication failed (401): use the Kimi Code console sk-kimi-xxx key, not an open-platform key.
messages.API key 已过期，请在 OpenCode Console 重新生成: API key expired; regenerate it in OpenCode Console
messages.已启用共享额度分组模式，但未配置任何分组: Shared-quota group mode is enabled but no groups are configured
messages.配置错误：用量查询需要 control_key（vela_ctrl_），模型 A: Configuration error: usage requires a control_key (vela_ctrl_); model API keys cannot query usage
messages.密码至少 6 位: Password must be at least 6 characters
messages.不能删除当前登录用户: You cannot delete the currently signed-in user
messages.至少保留一个管理员: At least one admin is required
messages.系统只存在一个管理员：不能创建新的管理员账号: The system supports only one admin; cannot create another admin
messages.配置文件不存在，请先运行 llm-usage config --init: Config file does not exist; run `llm-usage config --init` first
messages.未配置任何平台。运行 `llm-usage config --init` 生成模: No platforms configured. Run `llm-usage config --init` to generate a template.
